definitions.explanation: Regular attention to keep something in good condition.
A police raid or inspection, especially of illegal establishments.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}の{手入|てい}れをする。
{肌|はだ}の{手入|てい}れを{怠|おこた}らない。
{警察|けいさつ}の{手入|てい}れで{店|みせ}が{摘発|てきはつ}された。
examples.english: The shop was raided by the police.

notes:
FORMATION:
{手|て} (hand) + {入|い}れる (to put in)

Literally 'putting in hands' → giving attention to.

VERB FORMS:
・{手入|てい}れする - to maintain, to care for
・{手入|てい}れを{行|おこな}う - to perform maintenance (formal)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{庭|にわ}の{手入|てい}れ - garden maintenance
・{肌|はだ}/{髪|かみ}の{手入|てい}れ - skincare/haircare
・{道具|どうぐ}の{手入|てい}れ - tool maintenance
・{手入|てい}れが{行|い}き{届|とど}いている - well-maintained
・{警察|けいさつ}の{手入|てい}れ - police raid

SECOND MEANING:
The sense of 'raid' comes from the idea of police 'putting their hands into' an establishment.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・メンテナンス - maintenance (loanword)
・{整備|せいび} - maintenance (machines, systems)
・{世話|せわ} - care, looking after
